comments.comment: Sakoush Can you tell how to reproduce it ?

zjffdu I run spark in distributed mode (mesos) and try to read a json file from hdfs from a zeppelin notebook (built with spark 2.1.0 scala 11 hadoop 2.7). I tried to set zeppelin-interpreter/pom.xml to use lang3 ver 3.5 (as opposed to 3.4) but the build fails.

This works for spark 2.0.2 (which uses lang3 ver 3.3)

GitHub user zjffdu opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1910

ZEPPELIN-1977. spark 2.1 uses a more recent commons-lang3

      1. What is this PR for?
        The issue is that spark 2.1 use `commons-lang3` 3.5 while `zeppelin-interpreter` use 3.4. We can not just upgrade `commons-lang3` to 3.5, as it just make spark 2.1 work, but would fail other versions of spark. This PR remove `commons-lang3` from zeppelin-interpreter. We should keep zeppelin-interpreter's dependencies as minimum as possible. We can remove other dependencies (like `commons-lang`) from `zeppelin-interpreter` in a followup PR.

Issue I reported above yesterday turned to be a different root cause (although symptoms looks very similar),
specific for CDH Spark 2 (jira CDH-46402 - Spark2 lang3 dependencies).
Known issue as described in https://cloudera-portal.force.com/articles/KB_Article/Spark2-commons-lang3-serialization-error
That KB article provides a workaround for this issue,
but instead we’ve installed a bug-fix release of CDH Spark 2 that was released last week
http://community.cloudera.com/t5/Community-News-Release/ANNOUNCE-Spark-2-0-Release-2/m-p/51464#M161
and confirm that issue is fixed there too. Posting here just for record if anyone else runs into the same problem.
